en.curator.empty: No plugin-created skills yet — inspection only maintains skills distilled by reviews, never hand-written or market skills
en.curator.stateHelp: Status legend — active: injected into conversation catalogs; stale: unused beyond the stale threshold (marker only, still model-usable); archived: unused beyond the archive threshold, hidden from the model catalog (file kept, restorable anytime). Inspection runs daily, or on demand via the button above.
en.memory.empty: Both memory stores are empty — facts/preferences worth remembering will land here when a review spots them
en.memory.help: Long-term memory written on demand by background reviews: MEMORY holds environment/project facts, conventions and lessons; USER holds user profile and preferences. Memory is injected frozen at session start — writes (or hand edits) take effect at the NEXT session; the current session keeps its opening snapshot. Most reviews produce no memory. Edit files directly under
en.signal.accelerated: accelerated ({k}) — review fires at the next turn end
en.signal.help: A hit on any signal marks the window; the next completed turn-end fires a review regardless of thresholds (cooldown still applies). Signals: user aborting a turn, a burst of tool failures, or a correction word in a user message. A false trigger costs one cheap review — precision is the review agent’s job. Comma-separated word list, editable (saved on blur).
en.signal.stats: Recent signals: {t} (abort {a} · failures {f} · correction {c}) · triggered {r} reviews · yielded {y}
en.signal.title: Signal trigger
en.usage.empty: No usage yet — counts land here when the model loads a skill
en.usage.statusHelp: Status legend — model-visible: injected into every conversation catalog, loadable via the skill tool; hidden: marked disable-model-invocation, kept in the library but not injected; dash (—): in the calls column it means never invoked by the model, in the status column it means the skill is not in the current model catalog.
en.usage.summary: {n} calls total · {c} catalog entries · {z} never invoked
en.written.sessionEmpty: Nothing from this conversation yet — reviews appear here once the threshold fires
